description: This file defines the declaration of the 'Packager' class, a plugin component in the WPEFramework project. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and associated data structures relevant to a package management plugin that implements multiple interfaces related to plugin and web functionalities, as well as JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: Packager
classes.description: Represents a plugin component responsible for package management, supporting web and JSON-RPC interfaces, with internal notification handling.

classes.name: Packager::Params
classes.description: A JSON container structure for passing package installation parameters including package name, architecture, and version.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources during plugin deinitialization.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns informational string about the plugin.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
